## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:services` · `area:workflow` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-17T00:06Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p3:** two example flows author a key the schedule binding never reads (an AI metadata trap the designer now flags). Nothing runs differently.
- **Why `domain:services`:** `examples/*` belongs to the subsystem it exercises, here automation. Drop `objectName` from the two schedule start nodes.

Claim: PM loop round 3 of this seat's second term · 2026-10-17T04:32Z
Session: `session_018VqJPGA1NDNSCZsnecsChP` (the dispatching seat; the dev runs `mode:subagent` in this session's container and shares its session ID, so its identity is the branch)
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user, as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee from this act)
Branch: `claude/issue-24067-todo-schedule-objectname`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24067`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#2` (seat post #21118)
File surface (at `origin/main` `9ffe8af094` or later; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `examples/app-todo/src/flows/task.flow.ts`: drop `objectName` from the two schedule start nodes, `task_reminder` (`:52`) and `overdue_escalation` (`:161`). The `get_records` nodes keep theirs.
- one pin under `examples/app-todo/test/`: no `type: 'schedule'` flow in the example carries `objectName` on its start node.
Exclusions:
- ⛔ No spec change: whether the spec should refuse the key is the spec lane's call (the card's last section).
- ⛔ Not the engine, `trigger-schedule` or objectui.
- ⛔ No changeset: `@objectstack/example-todo` is `"private": true`, so the PR takes the `skip-changeset` label.
Container & model: `S: two keys and a pin ⇒ S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`TIER_DEFAULT`; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no. An example app's metadata loses a key nothing reads. No export, type or accept set moves.
Responsibility: `examples/app-todo (this lane; the example exercises automation): two schedule flows model a key the schedule binding never reads | the designer already flags it (objectui#12818) | every AI or author that copies the example`
Thread-read: 6227080875
Serial constraints cleared: this seat's other open PR, PR #24146, touches `plugin-approvals` only. No open PR touches `examples/app-todo/src/flows/`.
Premise to falsify first: on `origin/main`, `deriveTriggerBinding` lifts `config.objectName` only into the record-change binding, and both flows query `todo_task` explicitly in their `get_records` nodes.
